note: the label wanted is tested with `in` against the label on the tool, so a request for the saw answers with the jigsaw as well; the rule is the whole of what is on the handle and never a part of it
one mapping entry per loan, so a member's second loan replaces their first and only the last of them is ever shown; the rule is that a member may have more than one thing out at a time
the book's own list is sorted in place to print the slip, so printing leaves the book in an order nobody asked for; the rule is that the book holds its loans in the order they went out
